items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: You know you can’t do Mick Jagger. Mick Jagger is doing Mick Jagger.

ctx.x: But you know, I mean I’m making fun, but that wouldn’t work either because that’s been done. You know you can’t do Mick Jagger. Mick Jagger is doing Mick Jagger. You can’t do Aerosmith because Aerosmith is doing it. You’ve got to be new and different. And when you’re new and different then you risk being shut out if you’re too different. Like how did Kiss make it. How did they dress up in those costumes and they made it. I mean they were huge. Somebody had to have a good idea. And then somebody had to make it…
Just to wrap up, is there anything that really aggravates you on the bandstand?
